Dear Kiinteistöhuolto Ahola,

Thanks for getting in touch. We'll check current availability for the compact track loader for your requested dates and send over a quote as soon as we have that confirmed. Please note that availability is checked in our live booking system at the time of enquiry, so we'll confirm the actual dates before anything is locked in - and once the booking is confirmed, the quoted price is fixed for that booking.

We'll be in touch shortly with the quote.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
